title: Four steps, and you see your page before you pay
intro: No long contracts and no surprises.
step1_title: I make you a free first draft
step1_body: You tell me about your business and I put together your page with your name, your services and your area. It costs $0 and no card is needed.
step2_title: You review it and approve if you like it
step2_body: Ask for any changes you want. Only after you approve do you pay the $100 deposit. The balance is due when your page goes live.
step3_body: I publish it in your name: domain, page and accounts, with the form that alerts you when someone writes.
step4_title: I leave a guide for your team
step4_body: A short, clear guide so you and your staff know what to do when a new customer comes in. I walk you through it in person or by message.
note: No long contract and no card to start.
